Both decisions name existing candidate owners and real caller reasons for the four new named functions. Their final hashes include later notes; current documents are not themselves proof of original precode timing. The observed proof explicitly narrows that timing claim.

Sparse or contradictory struct geometry is explicitly held; no full canonical struct coverage is claimed or independently verified here.
